title: Discover USDKit and what’s new in OpenUSD
description: Dive into the latest advances in Universal Scene Description (USD) support on Apple platforms, including Swift-based USDKit, the new spatial preview API, and enhanced spatial web capabilities. Discover how the latest updates to the OpenUSD standard add support for accessibility, Gaussian splats, and compressed geometry. We’ll also walk through the expanded USD editing and rendering tools in Preview for Mac, showing you how to leverage these capabilities in your own apps.
